evidence.dom: **原本にシェアの数値開示なし＝刻みを導けないため空欄**。10-K FY2025(2025-11-28) Item1 COMPETITION 全文を確認したが、自社シェアも上位N社構造も一切数値が無く、むしろ逆方向の記述が並ぶ: 『We participate in a highly competitive and rapidly evolving environment where our competitors include companies of various sizes ... new entrants, and AI or cloud-native companies』『The markets for our solutions are characterized by rapid technological innovation, new industry standards, evolving distribution and sales models, **limited barriers to entry**, short product lifecycles, customer price sensitivity ... and the frequent entry of new solutions or competitors』。分野別も競合の列挙のみで数値なし(creative professionals向け: 『face broad competition from both established and emerging players』／marketing professionals向け: 『face broad competition from large, established enterprise software and cloud companies, point solutions from smaller, specialized companies』)。Item1A にも『Our competitors include companies with significant sales and research and development resources』『we face increasing competition from companies offering generative and agentic AI solutions』とあるのみ。旧dom=85の根拠は『Adobe PostScript/PDF standards』(実体は Publishing and Advertising＝売上の1.1%のレガシー区分の説明文)と『flagship creative applications』であり、**いずれもシェアの証拠ではない**。しかも旧evidence自身が『明示的シェア数値はhitsになし』と自認しながら85を入れていた。(出典: 10-K FY2025 Item 1 COMPETITION / Item 1A / https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/796343/000079634326000003/adbe-20251128.htm)
evidence.irr: 『end-to-end, ideation-to-creation platform』+PDF/PostScript規格。ただしPDFはオープン標準化済で規格ロックは弱め、プロ業務の再訓練コストは高摩擦→移行困難70。【2026-07-29 堀再監査・原本で85(認証・規格ロック)を否定 → 70を維持】10-K FY2025(adbe-20251128.htm)を全文走査。当社が規格を定め顧客を認定する構造は無い。『certif』の出現19件はすべて逆向き——(a)自社の有償研修の受講者向け『certifications delivered by our team of training professionals』、(b)自社が取得する側の『failure to fully meet information security control certification requirements』『significant investments…to obtain various security authorizations and certifications』(政府調達)。Item1 COMPETITION は当社が規格の**受け手**であることを明言する: 『The markets for our solutions are characterized by rapid technological innovation, **new industry standards**, evolving distribution and sales models, **limited barriers to entry**, short product lifecycles』。PDFに関する記述もAcrobat機能の説明のみで、規格所有・排他の主張は無い。→ プロ業務の再訓練コストによる**70=高摩擦移行困難**が上限。(出典: Adobe Inc. 10-K FY2025 Item1 COMPETITION / Item1A)
